title: ETH Zurich Student Summer Research Fellowship 2027

scenes.say: Want a fully paid summer of research at E T H Zurich, one of the best universities in the world? Here is how to apply.

items: 8 weeks of CS research: 2 July to 27 Aug 2027
Travel and visa costs paid back
scenes.say: Step one. What you get. Eight weeks of computer science research, from second July to twenty seventh August twenty twenty seven. Four thousand Swiss francs for housing and living, and your travel and visa costs are paid back.

items: 2 years of study done by July 2027
scenes.say: Step two. Who can apply. You must be studying now, in a bachelor's or master's in computer science, electrical engineering, maths or physics. Two years of study done by July twenty twenty seven, and graduating in twenty twenty eight or later. Indian students can apply.
Step three. Pick one or two research areas, like machine learning, security, systems, robotics, human computer interaction, theory or visual computing.
Step four. Keep these as P D F files. A Europass C V, your official transcript with G P A, and a one page motivation letter.
Step five. Apply online before sixteenth December, five thirty P M Indian time. Results come by the end of February.
Official links are in the description. Find more scholarships free on Marg Disha dot com.
